about.title: About Lumo
about.content:
Welcome to Lumo – The Gambia's trusted online marketplace!

We are a proudly Gambian e-commerce platform dedicated to bringing quality products directly to your doorstep. Whether you're in Banjul, Serekunda, Brikama, or anywhere upcountry, Lumo connects you with the products you love.

## Our Mission
To make online shopping accessible, reliable, and affordable for every Gambian.

## Why Choose Lumo?
- **100% Secure Payments**: Pay with Mobile Money (Wave, Afrimoney, QMoney), bank transfer, or Cash on Delivery
- **Fast Delivery**: 2-3 days in Greater Banjul Area, 5-7 days upcountry
- **Local Support**: Our customer service team speaks Wolof, Mandinka, and English
- **Quality Guaranteed**: All products inspected before shipping

shipping.title: Shipping Policy
shipping.content:
## Shipping Information for The Gambia

### Delivery Areas & Times

**Greater Banjul Area (GBA)**
- Banjul, Kanifing, Serekunda, Bakau, Fajara, Kololi
- Delivery: 2-3 business days
- Shipping fee: D150 or FREE on orders over D2,500

**West Coast Region**
- Brikama, Gunjur, Sanyang, Kartong
- Delivery: 3-4 business days
- Shipping fee: D250

**Upcountry Regions**
- North Bank, Lower River, Central River, Upper River
- Delivery: 5-7 business days
- Shipping fee: D350-500 depending on location

### Order Processing
- Orders placed before 2:00 PM WAT are processed same day
- Orders placed on weekends/holidays processed next business day
- You will receive SMS/WhatsApp confirmation with tracking

### Delivery Notes
- Our delivery team will call before arriving
- Please ensure someone is available to receive the package
- For Cash on Delivery, have exact amount ready
- Deliveries may be delayed during Ramadan, Tobaski, and other holidays

### Pickup Option
- Free pickup available at our Banjul location
- Bring your order confirmation and valid ID

### Questions?
WhatsApp: +220 XXX XXXX
Email: shipping@lumo-app.org

policy.title: Terms, Privacy & Return Policy
policy.content:
## Terms and Conditions

### 1. General Terms
By using Lumo, you agree to comply with The Gambia's e-commerce and consumer protection regulations. You must be at least 18 years old to make purchases.

### 2. Pricing & Currency
- All prices are displayed in Gambian Dalasi (GMD/D)
- Prices include applicable taxes
- We reserve the right to change prices without notice

### 3. Payment Methods
- Mobile Money: Wave, Afrimoney, QMoney
- Bank Transfer: Trust Bank, GT Bank, Access Bank
- Cash on Delivery (selected areas only)
- Card payments coming soon

---

## Privacy Policy

### Data We Collect
- Name, phone number, email address
- Delivery address
- Order history and preferences
- Device and location data (with your consent)

### How We Use Your Data
- Process and deliver your orders
- Send order updates via SMS/WhatsApp
- Improve our services
- Comply with The Gambia tax regulations

### Data Protection
- Your data is stored securely and encrypted
- We never sell your personal information
- Third-party sharing only for delivery fulfillment
- You can request data deletion anytime

### Cookies
We use cookies to improve your shopping experience. You can manage cookie preferences in your browser.

---

## Return & Refund Policy

### Return Window
- **7 days** for unused items in original packaging
- **14 days** for defective or damaged products
- Some items cannot be returned (see below)

### How to Return
1. Contact us via WhatsApp with your order number
2. Explain the reason for return
3. Wait for return authorization
4. Return item in original packaging

### Refund Process
- Refunds processed within 7-10 business days after receiving returned item
- Refund via original payment method or Mobile Money
- Shipping costs non-refundable for non-defective returns

### Non-Returnable Items
- Perishable goods (food, beverages)
- Personal care items (opened)
- Custom/personalized orders
- Items marked as 'Final Sale'
- Undergarments and swimwear

### Damaged or Wrong Items
If you receive a damaged or incorrect item:
1. Take photos immediately
2. Contact us within 48 hours
3. We will arrange replacement or full refund
4. Return shipping paid by Lumo

---

## Consumer Rights

As a consumer in The Gambia, you have the right to:
- Accurate product information
- Fair pricing and no hidden charges
- Safe and quality products
- Privacy and data protection
- File complaints with relevant authorities (PURA for electronic transactions)

---

Last updated: December 2025
Questions? Contact support@lumo-app.org
